beats.title: After the Globe fight, the Council imposes curfew and summons the Company
beats.summary: In the city center after escaping the fight at the Glimmering Globe, an announcement orders a curfew, postpones the festival, and summons the Questionable Company to the Mirathorn Council. The group heads toward the council building while trying to reunite with missing members, and Winna is persuaded to ignore the curfew and come along before she later returns to the Academy.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-13:3a1278d88978:span:3a1278d88978:14-14
anchor_quotes: As people are milling in the city center after escaping the fight in the Glimmering Globe
The Mirathorn Council has instituted a curfew and the festival has been postponed.
The Questionable Company is instructed to meet with the Council immediately.
Caelynn uses her badge to convince her that she should ignore the curfew and come with us to the council.
She hurries back to the academy with Karsemine following to help her.

beats.title: The Council meeting turns to rumors, martial law, and the swamp lead
beats.summary: Inside a smaller, guarded council room, the mayor questions the group about the bard incident and broader rumors. Caelynn calms the room, the group is assigned to report through Lysandra, Stafl uses Suggestion on Lysandra’s status, Bonogo presents his wanted poster, and the council is briefed about the Shepherd and a swamp to the north as the next investigative lead.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-13:3a1278d88978:span:3a1278d88978:16-16
anchor_quotes: The first question from Mayor Elara: why the group felt the need to kill the Bard during a competition.
She explains that, even after all the trouble the group has handled in the city already, she would have to institute martial law now.
Caelynn whistles to get everyone’s attention.
The mayor agrees and instructs the group to be added to the line of authority, reporting directly to Lysandra.
Stalf uses Suggestion to get Lysandra a promotion and increased pay.
Bonogo, suddenly remembering his wanted poster, shows it to the council.
Ephanna tells the council about the time they were locked up and about the Shepherd in a swamp.
The mayor requests help in scouting the area and reporting back on the scale of the problem in the area.

beats.title: Lysandra takes command and the group prepares for a long trip to the swamp
beats.summary: Lysandra is formally placed in charge of the group. Rurik directs them to Outtown for information, Thalia is ordered to supply resources, and after a brief emotional breakdown Lysandra regains composure and commits the Company to gathering provisions and traveling to the swamp for a two-week journey by horse.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-13:3a1278d88978:span:3a1278d88978:18-18
anchor_quotes: Lysandra has now been assigned to lead the group.
the best place to find details would be in Outtown.
Thalia, commander of the guard, is instructed to provide the group with all available resources.
The group will gather provisions and head to the swamp.
The journey will take about 2 weeks on horse and many towns await along the way.
